systems.system: Electronic Civil Registration and Vital Statistics (E-CRVS) system
systems.platform: online birth and death registration platform, operated under a public-private partnership with the technical partner the source spells Bankforte Technologies Limited
systems.tiers: operational in all 36 states and the Federal Capital Territory from 1 July 2026; the Commission has 4,011 functional registration centres of its own across the 774 local government areas and is expanding to about 8,000

note: The National Population Commission's chairman announced nationwide digital birth and death registration from 1 July 2026 through the Commission's own 4,011 registration centres across the 774 local government areas, a national agency's field offices; the local governments' association is a partner in decentralising the service and local councils are asked for support. No local government office is said to be connected or to work in the system, so no fact.
